idea-plugin.name: RefIo
idea-plugin.description:
RefIo — Local-First AI Coding Plugin for IntelliJ.

For developers who want the leverage of AI coding without giving up observability, model choice, or the native JetBrains experience.

An open-source AI coding plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, built in Kotlin. Native JetBrains UI, no WebView, no cloud account required. Works with local models (Ollama, LM Studio) or cloud LLMs.

Early-stage, actively developed. The foundation is in place — modular architecture, three execution modes, visible tool calls, file snapshots before writes. The depth is still growing. See the Roadmap for where the project is heading.

What it does today

  • Three execution modes — Chat (conversation, no tools), Plan (read-only analysis, code-enforced), Agent (file edits with snapshots before every write).
  • Local or cloud LLMs — Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Custom OpenAI, Z.AI. Universal tool-calling protocol works with models that lack native function calling.
  • Tool system — per-mode permissions (ON / ASK / OFF), PathSandbox with symlink resolution, CommandRule (regex allow/block/ask policies), snapshot + rollback.
  • Context control — @mentions for directing context (@file, @codebase, @diff, @problems, @terminal, and more), RAG with semantic chunking, token budgeting that scales to the model's context window.
  • Extensibility — subagents as Markdown + YAML (Claude Code compatible format), MCP protocol support (STDIO + HTTP/SSE) with built-in presets, project instructions via AGENTS.md and .refio/rules/*.md with glob-based activation.
  • Two interfaces, one core — native IntelliJ plugin + full terminal TUI share the same engine.
  • No-egress mode — blocks all cloud LLM calls at the client layer for strict offline work.

What it is, and what it isn't

It is: an early-stage open-source plugin with a clear direction — a native JetBrains tool for developers working in Kotlin, Java and JVM ecosystems, or anyone who wants their AI coding agent to run offline and be auditable.

It isn't: a drop-in replacement for inline completion (different category). A polished enterprise-grade product (not yet). Something you install and forget — changes happen fast at v0.0.1.x.

Known limitations (honest)

  • Orchestration is a light router + executors, not a deep agent engine.
  • No multi-agent runtime yet (Planner / Executor / Reviewer roles — roadmap).
  • No git worktree isolation per task — agents edit directly with snapshot rollback.
  • Planning loop is basic — no plan-refinement iteration yet.
  • Security layers are pragmatic v1, not hardened defense-in-depth.
  • Small commit history, fast changes, breaking changes possible pre-1.0.

Quick start — local models

ollama pull nomic-embed-text        # required for RAG
ollama pull qwen3.5:9b              # small and fast
# or for bigger hardware:
ollama pull qwen3.5:35b
ollama pull qwen3.5:122b
  1. Install the plugin from JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Open the RefIo tool window (right sidebar)
  3. Go to RefIo → Settings, pick your model
  4. Start with @codebase your question here

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 or newer (Community or Ultimate)
  • JDK 17+
  • Ollama or LM Studio (optional, for local models)

GitHub (MIT) | Roadmap | Privacy | Issues & Discussions

Built in Kotlin. Early-stage. Honest about what's done and what's next. Contributions welcome.
